Name: Furbys Alternate Dusty Portraits
Author: Furbling
Description:
My personal replacements for Dusty's portraits, designed to resemble a dog I had as a child. Made to resemble the vanilla portrait style and keep the same colors as his original portraits, though I did make him look older and rounder. This does not change any of his overworld sprites or edit and of his behaviours, just uses Content Patcher to replace the portrait file.

This is my first time trying to make a mod for SDV so if there are any issues let me know.
